defectFound.defect: projectone_dev did not exist. sys.databases held only master, model, msdb, tempdb.
defectFound.cause: Canonical Step 99 configured the database CONNECTION. Nothing ever created the database.
defectFound.misleadingSymptom: pyodbc reported 'Login failed for user delphics\\johnp' (18456). The operative error was 4060 — 'Cannot open database projectone_dev requested by the login'. SQL Server surfaces a login failure when it cannot open the requested database, so the message accuses authentication when the cause is a missing database. Diagnosing from the first line would have sent the owner into permissions troubleshooting.
defectFound.fix: CREATE DATABASE projectone_dev — empty, no schema, no tables.
defectFound.gateCheck: Environment setup, not implementation. Creating an empty database does not engage the Step 112 authorization gate.
defectFound.latency: Latent since Step 99 and invisible until the connection was exercised end to end, because a connection string never touches the server until used.
